question: A hospital can transport their patients either using a type II ambulance or hospital van. The hospital needs to transport 320 patients every day. A type II ambulance is mounted on a truck-style chassis and can move 20 patients every shift and costs the hospital (including gas and salary) $820. A hospital van can move 15 patients and costs the hospital $550 every shift. The hospital can have at most 60% of shifts be hospital vans due to union limitations of the type II ambulance drivers. How many of shift using each type of vehicle should be scheduled to minimize the total cost to the hospital?

import pyomo.environ as pyo

DATA = {
    # "The hospital needs to transport 320 patients every day."
    "patients_required": 320,
    # "A type II ambulance ... can move 20 patients every shift"
    "ambulance_capacity": 20,
    # "A hospital van can move 15 patients"
    "van_capacity": 15,
    # "costs the hospital (including gas and salary) $820"
    "ambulance_cost": 820,
    # "costs the hospital $550 every shift"
    "van_cost": 550,
    # "at most 60% of shifts be hospital vans"
    "van_share_max": 0.60,
    # vehicle index labels
    "vehicles": ["ambulance", "van"],
}


def build_model(data=None):
    d = data or DATA

    model = pyo.ConcreteModel()

    # --- Sets ---
    model.V = pyo.Set(initialize=d["vehicles"])

    # --- Variables ---
    # number of shifts scheduled for each vehicle type
    model.x = pyo.Var(model.V, within=pyo.NonNegativeIntegers)

    # --- Objective: minimise total cost ---
    def obj_rule(m):
        return (
            d["ambulance_cost"] * m.x["ambulance"]
            + d["van_cost"] * m.x["van"]
        )

    model.obj = pyo.Objective(rule=obj_rule, sense=pyo.minimize)

    # --- Constraints ---

    # Coverage: patients moved must meet the daily requirement
    def coverage_rule(m):
        return (
            d["ambulance_capacity"] * m.x["ambulance"]
            + d["van_capacity"] * m.x["van"]
            >= d["patients_required"]
        )

    model.coverage = pyo.Constraint(rule=coverage_rule)

    # Union limit: van shifts <= 60% of total shifts
    # x_van <= s * (x_amb + x_van)  ->  (1 - s) * x_van - s * x_amb <= 0
    def van_share_rule(m):
        s = d["van_share_max"]
        return (1 - s) * m.x["van"] - s * m.x["ambulance"] <= 0

    model.van_share = pyo.Constraint(rule=van_share_rule)

    return model

DATA = {
    "patients_required": 320,   # patients to transport every day
    "amb_capacity": 20,         # patients moved per type II ambulance shift
    "van_capacity": 15,         # patients moved per hospital van shift
    "amb_cost": 820,            # cost per type II ambulance shift ($)
    "van_cost": 550,            # cost per hospital van shift ($)
    "van_share_max": 0.60,      # at most 60% of shifts may be vans
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Decision variables
#   x_amb : number of type II ambulance shifts scheduled  (nonneg integer)
#   x_van : number of hospital van shifts scheduled       (nonneg integer)
#
# Objective (minimize): 820*x_amb + 550*x_van
#
# Constraints
#   (1) 20*x_amb + 15*x_van >= 320
#         -> enough capacity to move all 320 patients
#   (2) x_van <= 0.60*(x_amb + x_van)
#         -> at most 60% of shifts may be vans (union limitation)
#         linearised: 0.40*x_van - 0.60*x_amb <= 0
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------


def build_model(data=None):
    d = data or DATA

    model = pyo.ConcreteModel()

    # Decision variables
    model.x_amb = pyo.Var(within=pyo.NonNegativeIntegers)
    model.x_van = pyo.Var(within=pyo.NonNegativeIntegers)

    # Objective: minimize total cost
    model.obj = pyo.Objective(
        expr=d["amb_cost"] * model.x_amb + d["van_cost"] * model.x_van,
        sense=pyo.minimize,
    )

    # (1) Capacity: must be able to transport all required patients
    model.capacity = pyo.Constraint(
        expr=d["amb_capacity"] * model.x_amb
        + d["van_capacity"] * model.x_van
        >= d["patients_required"]
    )

    # (2) Union limitation: vans at most 60% of total shifts
    #     x_van <= van_share_max * (x_amb + x_van)
    #     => (1 - van_share_max) * x_van - van_share_max * x_amb <= 0
    model.van_share = pyo.Constraint(
        expr=(1 - d["van_share_max"]) * model.x_van
        - d["van_share_max"] * model.x_amb
        <= 0
    )

    return model
